Markets

Supported Markets

A multi-asset platform. These asset classes are displayed across the trading experience:

Crypto

e.g. BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, SOL/USDT, XRP/USDT

Forex

e.g. EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD

Stocks & Indices

e.g. AAPL, TSLA, SPX500

Precious Metals

e.g. XAU/USD (gold), XAG/USD (silver)

Energy & Commodities

e.g. WTI/USD (crude oil), NATGAS/USD

Availability of specific instruments is determined by the platform and is not a guarantee of execution on any specific asset.

Pricing

Kalderix Pro

Kalderix Pro
$7/month
No upfront subscription payment.
  • Create an account at no cost, anytime.
  • Fund your Live account and trade with real funds.
  • 14-day Live experience before the subscription is due.
  • $7/month subscription, deducted from your available balance.

No card required for the subscription. The $7 is deducted from your available Live trading balance when due.

Trading capital vs. subscription fee

Your trading balance is your trading capital. The $7 monthly charge is the Kalderix platform subscription fee, separate from your trading capital.

Your 14-day free Live period starts when you fund your Live account. After it ends, the first $7 is deducted, then $7 each month while the subscription is active.

If your available balance cannot cover the fee at billing time, no debt is created and your balance is never taken negative. The fee is retried on the next billing check; your funds remain available for trading and eligible withdrawals.

No card is ever required — the $7 is only ever deducted from your available platform balance.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Kalderix is an automated multi-asset trading platform built around arbitrage. It monitors supported markets for qualifying price discrepancies and automates eligible trades.

Arbitrage takes advantage of a price discrepancy for the same or a related asset across different markets. Kalderix identifies such opportunities among supported markets and automates execution.

New accounts include $50 in promotional trading credit. It is trading capital provided by Kalderix: you can run the bot with it immediately, profit on it is capped at $30, and it cannot be withdrawn. A deposit replaces it with your own funds.

No. The promotional credit is not a cash balance. Deposited funds are yours and can be withdrawn after a completed trade.

Switch to Live Mode in the dashboard, fund your Live account with USDT (TRC20), and start the bot once your account is funded and you meet the applicable eligibility requirements. Kalderix then automates eligible trades with your real funds.

No. You can fund your Live account and trade free for 14 days. The $7/month subscription only begins after your 14-day Live period ends — no payment is required upfront, and no card is ever required.

Once you fund your Live account, you get 14 days of free Live trading at no subscription cost. After those 14 days, the $7/month subscription applies to keep using the platform.

The Kalderix Pro subscription is $7/month, deducted from your available trading balance when due. Based on the current product model, there are no additional platform fees.

Live trading needs a funded Live wallet: make a deposit of at least $50. The $50 promotional credit is a separate trading credit, not a deposit, so it does not count towards that minimum. If your deposit is confirmed but Live trading is still unavailable, contact support.

You can withdraw to your own wallet address whenever eligible. Withdrawal processing usually takes 15–30 minutes, and applicable verification/security checks may apply.

Official Support will NEVER ask for
  • Your password

  • Private keys
  • Seed phrases
  • Wallet recovery phrases

Having a payment problem?

If a deposit is pending, delayed or looks wrong, it is safe to share only:

  • Invoice reference
  • Payment amount
  • Payment network
  • Transaction hash (if applicable)
  • A screenshot, when necessary
Help topics
My deposit is still pending

USDT (TRC20) deposits are detected automatically and usually confirm within a few minutes. Keep the invoice reference: official support can check the payment with it. Never send funds twice.

My payment failed or expired

An expired invoice is never credited. Generate a new invoice and pay the exact amount shown on the TRON (TRC20) network. If funds left your wallet, contact official support with the transaction hash.

Withdrawal requirements

Withdrawals require a confirmed deposit, at least one completed trade, and any security checks that apply to your account. The withdrawal page always shows the current requirements.

Keeping your account safe

Kalderix support only writes from official channels. Verify the destination before sharing anything, and never share the items listed in the security warning above.
